topic: Machine Learning for Lithium-Ion Battery State-of-Health Estimation and Remaining-Useful-Life Prediction

per_sentence.text: In a complementary line of work, Richardson et al. (2017) examined Gaussian process regression for forecasting battery state of health, noting that Gaussian processes are capable of handling the nonlinear data characteristic of battery degradation.

per_sentence.text: These shared concerns across mobility, grid, and consumer electronics motivate the development of data‑driven forecasting methods that can operate on large, high‑resolution datasets (Zhang et al., 2022).

per_sentence.text: Accurate prediction of battery state of health remains a critical need across applications ranging from electric vehicles and grid storage to portable electronics, where unanticipated capacity fade or resistance increase can directly compromise system reliability, safety, and cost (Richardson et al., 2017; Zhang et al., 2022).
